scientific_integrity: Standard incidence and time-average formulas are credited. Novelty concerns the localized crossing-cycle positivity criterion and its quantitative Cartesian-product consequences. Overlap with broader unpublished or unindexed sufficient conditions remains possible.
scientific_limitations: The crossing four-cycle condition is sufficient, not necessary; the gap constant need not be optimal. Valid for unweighted adjacency Hamiltonians on finite line graphs only. Verification samples are finite, while the general theorem is proved analytically.
title: Single-flat-band positive mixing for line graphs with crossing square cycles
